criteria.text: nested.flatten(items, depth=None) removes that many levels of list nesting: flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]], depth=1) is [1, 2, [3, [4]]], depth=0 returns a copy unchanged, and depth=None still flattens completely. A negative depth raises ValueError. Strings are never split into characters.
The whole test suite passes, and it has tests for this change that fail on the code as it was before the change.
CHANGELOG.md has a new bullet under 'Unreleased' that describes this change.
